title: Health Resort west wing room 222 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 222 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 222 key (W222 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 222.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to rooms 218 and 221 through the balconies.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 222 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 222:
  - 3× Sports bag
  - 2× Medbag
  - 1× weapon spawn on the bed (AKM, SV-98)
  - Loose loot (Roubles)
- Room 221:
  - 1× Weapon box (6x4)
  - 1× weapon spawn on the balcony (M4A1, M1A)
  - Loose loot (Currency, Meds, Medical supplies)
- Room 218:
  - Red keycard spawn location
  - 2× weapon cabinets
  - 2× Wooden crate
  - 1× weapon spawn in bathroom (RSASS)
  - Loose loot (Currency, Provisions, )
